//: What: npm manifest of the application router (@sap/approuter) - the single entry point in production that logs users in via XSUAA, forwards the JWT to the CAP service (destination srv-api) and serves the Fiori app.
Why: [CAP-M11] / [CAP-STAGE-06] browsers cannot do the OAuth flow themselves; generated by `cds add approuter` (CAP 10 places it in .deploy/app-router) and deployed as its own module in stage 10.
If missing or unlinked: In production users reach the service without a login page and requests arrive without a JWT, so every call is answered with 401.
name: procurement-approuter
